changes: Fixed a degenerate condition where we could try and perform a vehicle update step with less than the minimum delta time.

Fixed edge cases of anomaly being reported as between start and end when it actually isn't. - I don't know why I didn't think of this weeks ago. But let's actually get the TrueAnomalyInPatch logic actually working 100% of the time by normalizing the angles this time.
Serializes set Target IOrbiting object and deserializes on saves. So now when you set a target it is persisted in saves.
Render ocean mesh, using existing spherical billboard and tesselation techniques. Allow ocean to use a different meshCollection.
Add GPU compute-based frustum culling for the ocean. Culling is conservative with an optional tolerance based on the max wave displacement. Also cull using the planet for visibility.
Add Casper's optimized meshCollection and use it for the ocean
Improve refraction depth checks
Don't clip water surface underwater, even if it doesn't have proper shading yet
Move GetLod() method from Astronomical to MeshCollection
Tweak ocean settings to make waves more realistic in size
Fix visible terrain clipping near the camera when tesselation is off
Minor refactors and comments on the atmosphere code
Fix bound checks on multiple compute shaders
Fix some of the .png files I created used without compression
Fixed normalize in TrueAnomalyInPatch not working at -Pi.
Re-added reverse burn node dragging and improved on edge case failures.

Small improvement to the RCS controller which will not cancel out higher-than-normal rotation rates if they are going in the correct direction. This helps avoid unnecessary braking when e.g. switching to the relax profile in the middle of a slew.
Fixed TrueAnomalyInPatch unit test.
Added ability for a body to be set the target of multiple other bodies.
Added relative inclination readout to dN UI on target.
Add star reflections and ambient lighting to vessels

Added image based lighting to the vessels pbr using KSA star textures. Irradiance and prefiltered textures were generated offline. The stars reflections are attenuated to 0 when entering an atmosphere in order to prevent them conflicting with the atmosphere colors.
Fix duplicate ImageView creation in ModLibrary.cs
Fix cubemaps LayerCount incorrect in SimpleVkTexture.cs
Tidy lighting shader code
Remove "getPBRLightingLo()" shader function
Remove "fixedLighting()" shader function
Modified verbiage of map viewing and following to clarify controls.
Modified seek next behavior to change non-map following.
Added some handling to avoid creating burn nodes when attempting to change what you're viewing.
Increased the distance curve exponent for the burn node.
Changed the text color for the vehicle that is under control vs all other objects.
Removed an unnecessary log spam.
Fix ocean sky reflections causing fireflies with MSAA from long distances
Don't pass subdivisions manually from ocean tesselation control to evaluation stages
Fix EdgeTessellationFactor not computing the correct screenSpaceDistance
Improve ocean tesselation heuristic for lines going towards the horizon
Fix for menubar regression on secondary windows
Mouse input fix for cameras on secondary windows
Changed ability to collapse and move the temporary vehicle Burn UI.
Changed the placeholder angular momentum pointers UI inside a moveable Imgui header.
Added ability to toggle the angular momentum pointers UI on and off view the View menubar.
Added SpatialSoundData type. This allows for creating spatial presets which can be shared between sounds.
Added Default spatial sound data for engines.
Fix oceanRenderer culling descriptorPool running out of memory depending on requestedImageCount
Minor cleanup in oceanTessControl
Added Vessel Delta-V readout gauge.
Multi-window support for the sun and flare rendering (part 1)
Multi-window sunflare part 2

Added support for soundGroups. Each Sound may have one soundGroup which it subscribes to. SoundGroups allow concurrency control for playback of sounds within the group. You can set the max number of playing channels and the behavior for when that limit is reached.
Used existing total vehicle exhaust velocity to compute total vehicle specific impulse.
